svg.title: Rhesus macaque
svg.desc: Seated rhesus macaque with a tan-gray coat, bare pink-brown face, opposable hands and feet, and a long tail. Biological basis: Rhesus macaques are non-human primates used selectively when complex immune, neural, reproductive, or infectious-disease questions require close physiological similarity to humans.
